meta.title: Pepe Dome money planner
meta.description: Try for yourself what the Pepe Dome needs each month and what has to happen for it to pay for itself.

banner.example: These are example values, not the real Dome figures. The real values come from the environment variable PEPE_DOME_WERTE.

intro.title: The Pepe Dome in numbers
intro.text: A place like the Dome costs money every month, even when nobody is in the ring. In four short steps you will see where the money comes from, where it goes and what has to happen for it all to pay for itself.
intro.point1: All amounts are monthly averages, excluding VAT.
intro.point2: The planning year covers twelve months from {start}. In summer the café is open daily, in winter only on show days.
intro.point3: Afterwards you can turn every dial yourself. You cannot break anything.

fixed.title: What we pay every month anyway
fixed.text: These costs come whether shows are running or not.
fixed.after: This money has to come in every month before anything is left over.
fixed.heatingNote: Heating only costs money in winter. Here it is spread over all twelve months.

show.title: One show, worked through
show.text: Shows are the heart of the Dome. This is what a single show looks like:
show.perMonth: With {shows} shows a month that makes {amount}.
show.seats: The Dome has {seats} seats. With {guests} guests it is {percent} % full.

more.title: Classes, training and funding
more.text: Besides shows there is income that comes in every week or every month.

result.title: Does it pay for itself?
result.text: Everything together gives, per month on average:

calc.title: Try it yourself
calc.intro: Pick a template and move the sliders. The result changes immediately.
calc.mainIntro: These eight sliders already get you very far.

weakWinter.title: Weak winter
weakWinter.text: Half as much going on from November to February.

livingWage.title: Living from it
livingWage.text: The core team gets a salary you can live on.

expert.intro: Here you will find every single number the planner uses. All amounts excluding VAT.

money.title: Bank balance, loan and safety buffer

showsPerMonth.label: Shows per month
showsPerMonth.help: In a normal month. The season changes this further.

ticketPrice.label: Ticket price
ticketPrice.help: What a ticket brings in on average, discounts included.

cafeProfitPerGuest.label: Café profit per show guest
cafeProfitPerGuest.help: What is left per guest on show days after purchasing. Applies all year.

artistFeePerShow.label: Artist fee per show
artistFeePerShow.help: What the artists get for one show.

coursesPerWeek.label: Classes per week
coursesPerWeek.help: All classes together, for kids, teens and adults.

pricePerParticipant.label: Price per participant
pricePerParticipant.help: What one person pays per class on average.

profitPerWorkshopParticipant.label: Profit per workshop participant
profitPerWorkshopParticipant.help: What is left per person after all costs.

profiTrainingPerMonth.label: Pro training per month
profiTrainingPerMonth.help: Income from the open training for professionals.

fundingPerMonth.label: Funding per month
fundingPerMonth.help: Grants, for example from the city. Yearly amount divided by twelve.

rentalsPerMonth.label: Event rentals per month
rentalsPerMonth.help: When others rent the Dome for an occasion.

insurancePerMonth.label: Insurance per month
insurancePerMonth.help: Ongoing insurance, quarterly payments divided by three.

toiletsPerMonth.label: Toilets
toiletsPerMonth.help: Rent and cleaning of the toilets.

otherCostsPerMonth.label: Other
otherCostsPerMonth.help: All the small things that fit nowhere else.

heatingPerWinterMonth.label: Heating per winter month
heatingPerWinterMonth.help: Only in winter months. You choose which ones in the season section.

reservesPerMonth.label: Reserve
reservesPerMonth.help: Money set aside each month for surprises.

startingCash.label: Bank balance at the start
startingCash.help: Money in the account at the start of the planning year.

loanAmount.label: Loan
loanAmount.help: Paid into the account at the start. In the first year only interest is paid.

initialExpenses.label: Purchases at the start
initialExpenses.help: One-off spending at the start, for example fire safety, equipment or a stage.

liquidityBuffer.label: Safety buffer
liquidityBuffer.help: At least this much should always be in the account.

cafeDaysPerWeek.label: Café days per week in summer
cafeDaysPerWeek.help: Outside the winter months the café is also open without a show.

cafeProfitPerDay.label: Café profit per day
cafeProfitPerDay.help: What is left on a normal café day without show guests, after purchasing.

coreTeamCount.label: People in the core team
coreTeamCount.help: People who should live from the Dome.

salaryPerPerson.label: Salary per core team member
salaryPerPerson.help: What the Dome pays per person and month, including employer costs.

livingSalaryTarget.label: Target salary per person
livingSalaryTarget.help: From this amount you can live from it without working elsewhere.

partTimePerMonth.label: Part-time and mini jobs
partTimePerMonth.help: All part-time staff together per month.

oneOffFunding.label: One-off grants
oneOffFunding.help: For example state funding or a grant for materials. Paid into the account at the start.

fixedRentPerMonth.label: Fixed monthly rent
fixedRentPerMonth.help: For example the school. Runs all year, also during breaks.

rentalHoursPerWeek.label: Rental hours per week
rentalHoursPerWeek.help: For example aerial training of the acrobatics studio. Runs all year.

newIncomePerMonth.label: New income sources
newIncomePerMonth.help: Try how much a new idea would need to bring in per month.

trainerPerParticipant.label: Trainer per participant
trainerPerParticipant.help: What the trainer gets for each person in the class.

trainerCapPerCourse.label: Trainer maximum per class
trainerCapPerCourse.help: The trainer never gets more than this per class, even with many participants.

season.title: Season
season.intro: How much is going on in which month? 100 % is a normal month. Shows, classes, workshops, rentals and the café change with it, fixed costs do not. Tick the winter months: then the Dome is heated and the café only opens on show days.
season.planIntro: For months that are already booked, enter shows, guests per show and rentals directly. Empty fields use the average (grey).

result.notCarries: It does not pay for itself yet
result.warnZero: From {month} the account is in the red.
result.warnZeroStart: The account is already in the red at the start.
result.warnBuffer: From {month} there is less than the safety buffer of {buffer} in the account.
result.warnBufferStart: Already at the start there is less than the safety buffer of {buffer} in the account.
result.balanceOk: The account stays above the safety buffer all year.
result.vsPlan: {amount} per month compared with our plan

need.title: What has to happen?
need.missing: On average {amount} per month is missing. Any one of these changes alone would be enough:
need.surplus: On average {amount} per month is left over. This is how far things could drop before it tips:
need.overSeats: more than the {seats} seats in the Dome, so this alone is not enough
need.noEffect: does not help here, because costs rise with it
need.combine: Usually it is a mix: a few more guests, one more class, slightly lower costs.
need.notNeeded: even at zero the year stays positive
need.allSafe: Any one of these dials could drop to zero on its own and the year would still be positive.

chart.title: The year at a glance
chart.intro: Bars: result for the month. Line: bank balance at the end of the month.

scenario.changed: {count, plural, =0 {no changes} one {# value changed} other {# values changed}}
scenario.copyFailed: Copying did not work. Here is the link:
scenario.sharedInvalid: The link does not contain a valid scenario. The base values apply.
scenario.storageFailed: Saving did not work. Maybe the browser is in private mode.

export.note: All amounts excluding VAT. A planning aid, not accounting.

missions.title: Challenges
missions.intro: See how it feels when things get tight. Each challenge starts in a difficult situation. You solve the rest with the sliders.

noFunding.title: No funding
noFunding.goal: Get through a year without a loss although the funding stops.

weakWinter.title: Weak winter
weakWinter.goal: Stay above the safety buffer all year although winter is quiet.
weakWinter.rule: the season stays as it is

livingWage.title: Living from it
livingWage.goal: Pay the core team enough to live from the Dome and still get through a year without a loss.
livingWage.rule: salary at least the target salary, core team not smaller

safetyWork.title: Pay for the safety work
safetyWork.goal: Fire safety and technical work must be paid for without the account going into the red.
safetyWork.rule: purchases at the start stay at least as high

auth.title: Sign in
auth.intro: The money planner is only for the Pepe Dome team. Sign in with your account.
